messages:
incident-bot: Pager - Elevated 5xx rate on /v1/embeddings (us-west-2). Error spike started ~1712349600. Affected customers: search-heavy tenants and some enterprise similarity endpoints.
amy-oncall: Ack. Jumping on it. Any obvious recent deploys? :eyes:
liza-sre: No deploys in last 30m on serving. Metrics show request latency up and queue depth on embed workers spiking.
ryan-infra: Noted. PGPU pool for embeddings is near saturation; autoscaler didn't kick due to burst policy threshold.
amy-oncall: Can we do a live mitigation to reduce blast radius? Thinking per-endpoint quota tweak + route-specific rate limit on embeddings.
liza-sre: +1. Suggest temporary throttle: reduce embeddings rps by 60% for non-enterprise plans, preserve enterprise SLA routes. Also enable rerank fallback to CPU pool for best-effort traffic.
amy-oncall: How do we do that quickly? Runbook?
ryan-infra: Use admin control plane API. Example payload to add a per-route cap: ```
POST /admin/quotas
{
  "route": "/v1/embeddings",
  "scope": "plan:free,plan:pro",
  "rps_limit": 10,
  "duration_s": 1800,
  "reason": "live-mitigation-embeddings-spike-us-west-2"
}
```
mike-support: I'll draft proactive customer notes for affected tenants and flag any escalations. Which customers do we protect?
jane-prod: Protect enterprise-tier and any customers with reserved capacity. Call out that similarity/search customers might see degraded quality if we reroute to rerank fallback.
amy-oncall: Liza, can you apply the quota tweak? I can monitor. If you want, I can handoff after stable.
liza-sre: Applying now to non-enterprise scopes. Will route 30% of overflow to rerank CPU pool and throttle the rest.
incident-bot: Action log: quota_update applied by liza-sre at 1712349950. New per-route caps active.
amy-oncall: Seeing ingress drop on embeddings, 5xx falling. Queue depth decreasing. Watching logs for throttled client ids.
liza-sre: Adding temporary alert to watch for spillover to chat/rerank routes to avoid unexpected overload.
ryan-infra: Also lowered embeddings burst window so autoscaler will add nodes sooner if sustained.
mike-support: Sent customer note to top 8 impacted customers, flagged possible quality regression for those using rerank fallback.
jane-prod: Good. Can we keep this throttle for 30m then reassess? If stable, we can gradually relax. Also start postmortem stub.
amy-oncall: Will hand off to @liza-sre for post-incident follow-up in 15m. @liza-sre take it?
liza-sre: Taking. I'll monitor for 1 hour and start postmortem draft. Thanks. :thumbsup:
amy-oncall: Handing off — I'm going offline in 10. If anything spikes, page me.
incident-bot: Handoff note: amy-oncall -> liza-sre at 1712350200. Paging rules unchanged.
liza-sre: Closing mitigation loop: plan is 30m throttle then 30m gradual ramp. Postmortem will include root cause (autoscaler threshold + burst pattern) and action items: lower autoscale threshold, implement per-customer circuit breaker, improve per-route surge detection.
amy-oncall: Thanks team.
